subject: Reasoning
description: Word/number sorting + alternating step machine I/O puzzles

questions.stem: Input: 25 14 81 49 36. Step 1: 14 25 81 49 36 (smallest first). Each subsequent step swaps next pair. Step 2 will be:
questions.explanation: Step 1: smallest among 25, 14, 81, 49, 36 = 14 → goes to front: 14 25 81 49 36. Step 2: smallest among remaining (25, 81, 49, 36) = 25 already in 2nd → smallest after 25 = 36? Wait — pattern depends on rule. With sort-bubbling, step 2 = 14 25 49 81 36 (swap 81+49). Final fully sorted: 14 25 36 49 81. Distractor 4 is final state. Distractor 1 jumps too far.

questions.stem: Input: car bus tree apple sky. Output (alphabetical): apple bus car sky tree. How many steps in this rearrangement (one element per step)?
questions.explanation: Sorting alphabetically (one element placed per step): step 1 places 'apple' to front; step 2 places 'bus'; step 3 places 'car'; step 4 places 'sky' — at this point 'tree' is automatically last (n−1 steps for n items). For 5 items = 4 steps.

questions.stem: Machine takes input '17 32 15 8 41' and gives output of largest number sorted to back, one per step. Step 1 yields:
questions.explanation: Largest = 41, already at last position → step 1 keeps array unchanged. Step 2 places next largest (32) → 17 15 8 32 41. Step 3: 17 8 15 32 41 (place 17 next? actually next largest after 32 is 17). Step 4: 8 15 17 32 41 (final sorted).

questions.stem: Input: 34 16 25 47 12. After 1 step (smallest moves to front): 12 34 16 25 47. After 2 more steps, what is at position 3?
questions.explanation: After step 1: 12 34 16 25 47. Step 2 (smallest of remaining 34, 16, 25, 47 = 16 → moves to position 2): 12 16 34 25 47. Step 3 (smallest of remaining 34, 25, 47 = 25 → moves to position 3): 12 16 25 34 47. Position 3 = 25 ✓.

questions.stem: Input: tea milk water juice. Sorted by length (shortest first): tea milk juice water. Step 1 (move shortest to front) gives:

options.option_text: milk tea water juice positions changed

questions.explanation: Lengths: tea (3), milk (4), water (5), juice (5). Shortest = tea (3) — already at position 1 → no change. Note 'water' + 'juice' both have 5 letters; they tie — problem of stable sort. Final fully length-sorted: tea milk juice water (alphabetical tie-break: juice < water).

questions.stem: Input: 8 21 5 13 17. Each step moves the next-smallest unplaced number to the front (already-placed elements shift right). After 3 steps:
questions.explanation: Step 1: smallest = 5 → front: 5 8 21 13 17. Step 2: next smallest = 8 → already at position 2: 5 8 21 13 17 (or some interpretations move 8 to position 2 explicitly). Step 3: next smallest = 13 → moves: 5 8 13 21 17. Position layout: 5 8 13 21 17. ✓
